status_note: This manifest is INTENTIONALLY sparse: only v0 (the unoptimized baseline) and v12 (the shipped AHCIP-only Auditor) are canonical / active. The archived v1–v11 prompts exist on disk under prompts/v{1..11}/auditor_prompt.txt for historical reference but are NOT entered here. See `archived_versions` below for a short reason per version. Adding MANIFEST entries for v1–v11 would require fabricating R/P values, which is explicitly out of scope (see audit task t_415b1e9b, 2026-06-22).
hash_chain_implementations_note: Two parallel SHA-256 hash-chain implementations of the audit_trail chain exist in this repo. The LIVE, WIRED one is `src/ai_billing_audit/audit_actions.py` — its canonical entry point is `audit_actions.append()`, which is called from 8 sites in `src/ai_billing_audit/api.py` and `src/ai_billing_audit/contact.py`. The ORPHAN / test-only one is `src/audit_log.py` (sibling of `audit_trail.sql`, NOT under the package); it is imported only by `tests/test_audit_log.py` and the `scripts/qa_audit_chain_*.py` verification scripts and is NOT invoked at runtime. The marketing security page (`apps/portal/src/app/security/page.tsx`) is required to cite the live, wired module (`src/ai_billing_audit/audit_actions.py` / `audit_actions.append()`) — citing `src/audit_log.py` there is a documentation bug. Do NOT delete `src/audit_log.py` until the 13 unit tests in `tests/test_audit_log.py` and the 2 qa scripts are migrated to the wired module (see audit tasks t_f083eb03 and t_165297e9, 2026-06-22).
notes: Append-only manifest of prompt optimization runs. Each new optimization pass appends one entry to `entries`; existing entries are never modified or reordered. The diff between an entry's `version_hash`/`parent_hash` and its `optimizer_config` represents what the optimizer changed relative to the previous run. To add a run: append a new entry, set its `parent_hash` to the previous entry's `version_hash`, and compute `version_hash` over the new prompt content.
